namespace: 64 lowercase hex; nms_scope(origin_account,identity); original namespace is immutable across an explicit account merge
account: authenticated owner; follows account merge and purge
origin_account: immutable namespace provenance, not authorization; retained only with its owned row
identity: canonical 64 lowercase hex key for this journal
revision: 0 through 2147483647; serialized by the row transaction
pruned: monotone history-incomplete flag, cleared only by explicit fresh-proof wipe
document: complete NCJ2 bytes, at most 8388608; new journal is its 68-byte header
admission: authenticated current owner and canonical identity; integrity plus actual original ID/signature verification on mount; never accept CJO_CUT for a committed database row
merge: preserve original namespaces; if multiple owned journals match the current identity, report incomplete and require explicit reconciliation rather than overwrite one
